description: Evaluate a polynomial at one query through reciprocal nodal-product weights and the second barycentric form over F_998244353.

source.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, §3.3(i), Eq. 3.3.1
source.role: mathematical algorithm description only; no copied code or task material

contract.operation: Evaluate the unique degree-below-N interpolant at q with the second barycentric formula.
contract.primary_method: Precompute w_i=1/product_(j!=i)(x_i-x_j), then compute (sum_i w_i*y_i/(q-x_i))/(sum_i w_i/(q-x_i)); return y_i directly if q=x_i.
contract.independent_method: Solve the Vandermonde system for monomial coefficients by modular Gauss-Jordan elimination and evaluate with Horner's rule.
contract.duplicate_rationale: Existing polynomial_interpolation emits monomial coefficients after constructing Lagrange basis polynomials; Newton divided-difference evaluation uses a different basis and recurrence. No local package evaluates a single query using reciprocal nodal-product weights and the barycentric quotient.

workspace.meaning: Eight fixed i64 barycentric weights plus scalar state and conservative alignment allowance; native ports allocate no dynamic storage.

complexity.native_primary_time: O(N^2 + N log p) field operations, including one modular inverse for each nodal product and each query difference
complexity.independent_reference_time: O(N^3 + N log p) using modular Gauss-Jordan elimination and Horner evaluation
complexity.independent_reference_auxiliary_space: O(N^2) for the small augmented Vandermonde matrix
